greeting: Hi there! I hope you're having a good day. I'd like to get to know you better.

questions.question: What do you enjoy doing in your free time? Any hobbies or activities you love?
Is there a movie, book, or TV series that you've recently enjoyed or has left a lasting impression on you?
When it comes to food, do you have a favorite cuisine, dish, or snack that makes you happy?
Do you like spending time outdoors? If so, what kind of activities do you enjoy—hiking, biking, or something else?
What kind of music or other forms of entertainment do you find uplifting or inspiring?
